author: Jason Stys
summary: Filter captured events by exact UTC/protocol/rule/severity with snapshot/query-bound pagination and persistent visibility of capture gaps.
rationale: Makes defensive investigation manageable without presenting filtered or incomplete captures as clean traffic.
limitations: The original 100-item detector evidence cap remains; a filtered event page does not include every related packet.
Capture-quality issues lack reliable timestamps and remain visible outside event time filters.
No live capture, blocking or attribution is supplied; no findings is not proof of safe traffic.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
